parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results. If you leave this parameter empty, the query starts from the beginning.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID. You can call the [ListRegions](url) view.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun emr list-components --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --cluster-id C-8CFEBCCFFEF50000 --next-token example-string --max-results 10 --application-names KNOX --component-names KNOX --component-states INSTALLED --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun emr ListComponents --region cn-hangzhou --ApplicationNames.1 KNOX --NextToken 'example-string' --ClusterId 'C-8CFEBCCFFEF50000' --MaxResults 10 --ComponentStates.1 INSTALLED --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --ComponentNames.1 KNOX --method POST --force
